notes_for_editor: Only two sources. Two searches, the Forest Lookouts Tennessee index and the NHLR Tennessee index found no build date, designer, staffing or fire record for this Pilot Mountain. The Landforms code GB2610 is recorded as an NGS register in the record, but the Landforms page has no legend, so the NGS label is unverified and was not corrected. Do not confuse with Pilot Mountain in Transylvania County, North Carolina (data/towers/nc/us-nc-pilot-mountain.json). The Pilot record's note places this mountain near Sunbright; no page we fetched confirms that, so the story does not repeat it. A Morgan County fire tower moved near Wartburg (tngenweb.org/morgan/fire-tower-oakdale-lancing/) has no date or link to this mountain, so it is not used. Confidence is medium only for identity, county, elevation and the 2014 listing.
